parameters.name: NeedStatusNotify
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable callbacks for recording status. Valid values:

*   true: enables callbacks for recording status. If you set this parameter to **true**, an example of recording status callback is returned.
*   false (default): disables callbacks for recording status.

parameters.name: NotifyUrl
parameters.description:
The callback URL that is used to receive notifications about recording events and status.

>  The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`. For more information, see [Callbacks for live stream recording](~~55016~~).

parameters.name: OnDemandUrl
parameters.description:
The callback URL for on-demand recordings.

>  The URL must start with `http://` or `https://`. For more information, see [On-demand recording](~~85910~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live add-live-record-notify-config --domain-name example.com --notify-url http://demo.aliyundoc.com/examplecallback.action --need-status-notify false --on-demand-url http://learn.aliyundoc.com/ondemandcallback.action --notify-req-auth true --notify-auth-key chenhuanxin249088 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live AddLiveRecordNotifyConfig --region cn-hangzhou --DomainName 'example.com' --NeedStatusNotify false --OnDemandUrl 'http://learn.aliyundoc.com/ondemandcallback.action' --NotifyUrl 'http://demo.aliyundoc.com/examplecallback.action' --NotifyReqAuth true --NotifyAuthKey chenhuanxin249088
